attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: tts_playback_sentence_highlighting
steps:
  - id: receive_cleaned_text
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/tts/cleaned-text-sections"
    output: raw_text_sections

  - id: validate_text_sections
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_text_sections
      schema: cleaned_text_sections_schema
    output: validated_text_sections

  - id: extract_user_config
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/tts/user-config"
    output: raw_user_config

  - id: validate_user_config
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_user_config
      schema: tts_user_config_schema
    output: validated_user_config

  - id: split_sections_into_sentences
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_text_sections
      operation: split_to_sentences
      delimiter: "sentence_boundary"
    output: sections_with_sentences

  - id: transform_sentences_to_utterances
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: sections_with_sentences
      mapping:
        source_field: "sentences"
        target_structure: "utterance_queue_items"
        include_section_index: true
        include_sentence_index: true
    output: utterance_items

  - id: merge_config_with_utterances
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: utterance_items
      secondary: validated_user_config
      join_key: "broadcast_key"
      merge_fields:
        - "rate"
        - "pitch"
        - "inter_section_pause_ms"
    output: configured_utterances

  - id: apply_pause_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: configured_utterances
      rule: "insert_pause_between_sections"
      condition: "section_index changes"
      action: "insert_silence_utterance_with_duration_from_inter_section_pause_ms"
    output: utterance_queue_with_pauses

  - id: format_utterance_queue
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: utterance_queue_with_pauses
      format: "json"
      template: "web_speech_api_utterance_queue"
    output: formatted_utterance_queue

  - id: authenticate_playback_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "tts_listener"
    output: auth_result

  - id: log_playback_start
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_utterance_queue
      action: "tts_playback_initiated"
      details:
        total_utterances: "count(formatted_utterance_queue)"
        language: "fr"
    output: audit_entry

  - id: send_utterance_queue_to_client
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: formatted_utterance_queue
      url: "/client/tts/enqueue-utterances"
      method: "POST"
      headers:
        content_type: "application/json"
    output: enqueue_result

  - id: wait_for_utterance_start_events
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      condition: "utterance_start_event_received == true"
      timeout_ms: 30000
    output: utterance_event

  - id: extract_active_sentence_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: utterance_event
      field: "sentence_id"
    output: active_sentence_id

  - id: send_highlight_command
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: active_sentence_id
      url: "/client/tts/highlight-sentence"
      method: "POST"
      headers:
        content_type: "application/json"
      body:
        sentence_id: "active_sentence_id"
        action: "highlight_and_scroll_into_view"
    output: highlight_result

  - id: loop_remaining_utterances
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: formatted_utterance_queue
      iterate_step: wait_for_utterance_start_events
    output: all_highlight_results

  - id: handle_tts_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: send_utterance_queue_to_client
      on_error: "log_and_notify"
    output: error_handling_result

  - id: retry_on_failure
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: send_utterance_queue_to_client
      retries: 3
      backoff_ms: 1000
    output: retry_result

  - id: notify_playback_complete
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: all_highlight_results
      message: "TTS playback of French text is complete."
      channel: "in_app"
    output: notification_result

  - id: log_playback_complete
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: all_highlight_results
      action: "tts_playback_completed"
      details:
        status: "success"
    output: final_audit_entry

  - id: end_workflow
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
